nom: Caudalie Premier Cru Anti-Aging Eye Cream for Fine Lines & Wrinkles - 15 mL

avis.titre: Hydrating and gentle on the eyes
avis.texte: This eye cream feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and keeps the under-eye area hydrated without feeling greasy. It layers well under makeup and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. A little goes a long way, and the applicator makes it easy to use. Highly recommend!

I discovered this brand when I went to a French pharmacy in Paris. All safe and non toxic, so I use most of their skincare products. This eye serum was a little pricier than the one from them I tried previously but this one has more anti aging properties and reduces dark circles so it’s worth it. I love it.

avis.titre: No eye wrinkles in 20 years with this
avis.texte: Have ordered it from Prine ever since running out of each each year that I bought it in Paris at City Pharma! It is the best, IMO, since I have practically no lines around my eyes since I’ve been using for over 20 years! And I’m 76♥️
One of the best under eye creams I have ever used. I have been using it for years!

avis.titre: Be careful! Allergic reaction despite prior tolerance
avis.texte: I got an allergic reaction around my eyes with redness, itching, swelling, peeling and dryness. I had used this before(2022-2023 with no issues), not sure if something in the formula changed so be careful !
I love the Caudalie products and this eye cream did not disappoint. So satiny smooth to apply and my eyes look brighter and fine lines reduced.
Love this! I have dry skin and it helped even in a Canadian winter.

I’ve been using this product for a few weeks, and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, making it perfect for both morning and nighttime use. It delivers great hydration, reducing the appearance of fine lines and puffiness without feeling heavy. The cooling effect is a nice bonus, especially for tired eyes. While it takes some time to see long-term results, I’ve noticed a visible improvement in my under-eye area’s brightness and smoothness. Overall, it’s a great option for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective eye cream!
